method: Monthly fund marks. Funds file about 60 days after period end, so the newest mark lags the market. Not live trade prices.
ytm_method: Yield to maturity computed by Kilambi Research from price, coupon and maturity: semiannual compounding, 30/360 day count, settlement at the report period end for marks and at the trade date for TRACE prints. Convertible yields are straight-bond yields and ignore the conversion option. A yield is shown only where coupon and maturity are on record.
